conflicts.title: Profile sync: Q5 'no profile sync needed' vs Q42 'separate secret, good to deploy' (Q52/Q54/Q66 defaults)
facts: Profile sync is already BUILT on Android (data/sync/* ~1,290 lines, ~20 SyncEntry sites, LinkDeviceScreen, ProfileSection) and dormant: config/endpoints.green.json has no profileSyncBase, and nothing provisions ProfileSecretStore.ENROLL_TOKEN, so even a deployed Lambda would refuse enrollment.
Account deletion IS wired already (ServicesGraph.kt:565-590 deleteCloudDocs/deleteCloudProfile + PendingCloudErasure retry) - Q54's 'deleteProfile() not called' is stale.
Q75(b) 'cloud sync of Imported-songs' only exists if profile sync exists.
Q10 caveat: CredentialsSync would copy the OpenSearch keys into the synced settings-credentials doc if sync goes live, contradicting 'keystore local'.
Cost: leave dormant = 0; deploy = S code (~80) + Levi AWS deploy; full removal = L (~2,000 lines, touches onboarding/*, a polish-gated dir).
conflicts.proposal: Follow Q42 (the later, more specific answer): deploy the profile-sync Lambda to green with its own ENROLL_SECRET, but ship sync OPT-IN and OFF by default (Settings > Profile 'Sync across devices'); no account exists unless the user turns it on. Provision the enroll token at runtime through the same endpoints-doc 'capabilities' channel Q69 adds (so it is rotatable). Strip the search keys from the Android credentials doc (Q10). Read Q5 as 'not required for v1 / never forced on users'. Do NOT remove the code.
conflicts.if_levi_says_q5: Skip ANS-SYNC-1 entirely; sync stays dormant (no removal - removal costs L and touches onboarding); drop Q75(b); the Play deletion page only covers rec-engine/pockets data.

conflicts.title: Location: Q89 'build location engine and request permission' vs release plan A2 'drop ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION from v1'
facts: The engine already exists (COL-20, wave 22): data/location/{DwellDetector,FusedVisitSource,ListeningPlaceEngine,ListeningPlacesStore,LocationSettings}.kt + Settings > places & trips (ListeningLocationSection, order 665); Q89(b) was asked before COL-20 landed.

Background location is declared (AndroidManifest.xml:16) and requested ('Allow Always', ListeningLocationSection.kt:50,178-190). Its only purpose is 'notice trips between your places while music plays in the background'.
Q14 (handed to the polish branch) says 'request all permissions needed' - the polish branch must not add a background-location prompt if C2 lands as proposed.
conflicts.proposal: Keep the engine and request foreground location (COARSE+FINE, opt-in from the Settings toggle) - that satisfies Q89. Drop ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION in every build. Keep 'trips while music plays in the background' working by adding the `location` foregroundServiceType to PlaybackService, started only while audio plays AND places & trips is on (Android 14+ allows a while-in-use location FGS started from the foreground). Play then needs only the FGS-location declaration, not the background-location declaration + video. Places stop updating when nothing is playing (acceptable: plays are what get stamped).
conflicts.if_levi_says_keep_background: Keep ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION only in the `direct` (sideload) flavor once release plan A1 adds flavors; the Play flavor removes it with tools:node="remove".
